title: Last Quarter Moon, 9° Leo
lines: Tonight 20:29 UTC the Moon squares the Sun: half lit, half dark.
caption:
Last Quarter Moon at 9°26' Leo tonight, Nov 1, 20:29 UTC. 🌗

Vedic astrology places this Moon in the star Pushya, the nourisher, ruled by Saturn.

title: Mercury meets the Sun tomorrow
lines: On Nov 4, Mercury and the Sun are conjunct at 12°11' Scorpio.
caption:
Mercury meets the Sun tomorrow. ☿

On Nov 4 at 14:30 UTC retrograde Mercury and the Sun are conjunct at 12°11' Scorpio, the midpoint of this retrograde. Today Mercury is at 13° Scorpio and closing.

Within 17 arcminutes of the Sun, traditional astrology calls a planet cazimi, 'in the heart of the Sun'. At its closest Mercury is 22' away, just outside. Vedic astrology calls it combust (asta).

title: Venus sextile Jupiter
lines: At 24°43' Libra/Leo, Venus links with Jupiter: generosity and ease.
caption:
Venus sextile Jupiter today, Nov 4, at 24°43' Libra/Leo. 💫

A sextile is two planets 60° apart: a supportive link that needs a small action to use. Venus (retrograde in Libra) and Jupiter (Leo) are the two classical benefics, so this tends to favor kindness, generosity and honest affection.

Best use: say the warm thing aloud, ask the friendly question.

title: Vishakha, the Vedic star
lines: Mercury stationed in Vishakha on Oct 24; the New Moon is in it on Nov 9.
caption:
Vishakha: the Vedic star behind this retrograde. ✦

Vedic astrology divides the zodiac into 27 stars, the nakshatras. Mercury stationed retrograde in Vishakha on Oct 24, and the New Moon on Nov 9 falls in it too.

Vishakha means 'forked branch' and spans 20° Libra to 3°20' Scorpio (sidereal). Its theme is the drive to reach a goal, whatever the road.
